features: Fixed a bug where creating a supplementary installment plan on an over-budget expense item would silently do nothing if the suggested amount was left untouched: no navigation, no error shown. The cause was in how the amount was converted internally before being sent to the server. The plan now saves correctly whether the amount is edited or not.

Also fixed a side effect of the same bug: some on-screen figures (such as the selected total or the chapter's remaining budget) could appear multiplied by 100 compared to their real value, due to an ambiguous number-format interpretation.

Realigned the "Supplementary Installment" label in the invoice over-budget dialog and in the in-app invoice guide: they showed "Generate new plan" for the exact same strategy that is labeled "Supplementary Installment" everywhere else in the app — no behavior change, just consistent wording.
